These features are more typical of an IDH-mutant diffuse glioma than an IDH-wildtype aggressive phenotype. Evidence arguing against IDH-mutant includes age_years of 52 and a relatively large ED Volume with ventricular effacement/asymmetry, which can be seen with more aggressive disease. Overall, the nonenhancing cortical hemispheric pattern outweighs the age and mass-effect concerns, so the best estimate is IDH-mutant.

overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structured conventional MRI metadata. The lesion is predominantly nonenhancing FLAIR abnormality with minimal mass effect, which supports a lower-grade adult-type diffuse glioma, but molecular subtype certainty is limited without tissue diagnosis.
